s: What is the planned capacity of the green urea plant at the Poodimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub?
x: The plant is planned at 1,000 tonnes of green urea per day, with inputs from NTPC Green Energy.

s: Who is developing the green ammonia project for which the foundation stone was laid at Kakinada?
x: The Kakinada green ammonia project is being developed by AM Green, part of the Greenko Group. Uniper is the key offtaker, while Petronas and GIC are among the backers.

s: What is the initial investment in the Kakinada green ammonia project?
x: The initial investment is ₹18,000 crore over 495 acres.

s: Where is India's first and the world's largest green ammonia project located?
x: The Kakinada project is described as India's first and the world's largest green ammonia project.

s: The Kakinada green ammonia project is a brownfield conversion of which plant?
x: The project converts the existing Nagarjuna Fertilisers plant at Kakinada.

s: Under which policy is the Kakinada green ammonia project being developed?
x: The project is being developed under the Integrated Clean Energy (ICE) Policy, 2024. The National Green Hydrogen Mission is relevant to the target comparison, while the EU RFNBO standard and the Transitioning Industrial Clusters initiative are associated with other aspects of the project.

s: With reference to the Kakinada green ammonia project, which pair (country – entity) is correctly matched?
x: ADIA is the UAE backer. Uniper is German, Petronas Malaysian and GIC Singaporean.

s: Under the AM Green–Uniper agreement, from which year will 5 lakh tonnes per year be supplied from the Kakinada plant?
x: The agreement provides for 5 lakh tonnes per year from 2028, meeting the EU RFNBO standard.

s: India’s first large-scale indigenous green urea plant at the Poodimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub is being established through an MoU between which two organisations?
o: NTPC Green Energy and Asago Industries
Waaree Energies and NTPC Green Energy
x: The MoU for India’s first large-scale indigenous green urea plant was signed between NTPC Green Energy and Asago Industries. The project site is the Poodimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub near Visakhapatnam.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Poodimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub?
o: It is to produce green methanol.
It is to produce sustainable aviation fuel.
Its green urea project aims to cut urea imports by 8–10 million tonnes.
It is India's first commercial green ammonia plant.
x: India's first commercial green ammonia plant is AM Green's Kakinada project; Poodimadaka is the green hydrogen hub with the green urea plant.

s: Over how much area is the Kakinada green ammonia project of AM Green spread?
x: The Kakinada project covers 495 acres with an initial investment of ₹18,000 crore.

s: By which year is the Kakinada green ammonia project to reach its full capacity of 1.5 MTPA?
x: Capacity comes in phases: 0.5 MTPA by 2027, 1 MTPA by 2028 and the full 1.5 MTPA by 2030.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: Poodimadaka hosts the green hydrogen hub and green urea plant; Kakinada has the green ammonia project and Rambilli the Waaree gigafactory.

s: Which German company is the main buyer of green ammonia from Kakinada, the first green energy export from India to Europe?
x: Uniper (Germany) will buy 5 lakh tonnes a year from 2028 – India's first green energy export to Europe.

s: Which two AP locations are among JERA's proposed green ammonia sites?
x: Krishnapatnam and Moolapeta are among JERA's proposed green ammonia locations.

s: AM Green's target of 5 million tonnes of green ammonia by 2032 is about what share of the National Green Hydrogen Mission targets?
x: The 5 million tonne target by 2032 is about 20% of the National Green Hydrogen Mission targets.

s: Waaree Energies’ integrated lithium-ion battery gigafactory, described as India’s largest, is being established at which location with a planned capacity of 16 GWh?
x: Waaree Energies’ integrated lithium-ion battery gigafactory is being established at Rambilli in Anakapalli district, with a planned capacity of 16 GWh. Poodimadaka is associated with the green urea plant, not this battery project.

s: SIPB, chaired by the Chief Minister, gave in-principle approval to Waaree Energies' project for manufacturing what?
x: The SIPB approved Waaree’s lithium-ion project for cells, battery packs and battery energy storage systems (BESS).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about handloom projects in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Integrated Handloom Development Pilot Project is valued at ₹100 crore
The Dharmavaram mega cluster project costs ₹38.31 crore
The Unity Mall is planned at Timmapuram on the Visakhapatnam–Bheemunipatnam Road
The One District One Product initiative was launched in 1999
x: The ODOP initiative was launched in 2018, not 1999.

s: In which year was NMDC, a partner in the Gangavaram Port iron ore blending MoU, established?
x: NMDC was established in 1958; 1942 is the founding year of Vale S.A.

s: The Adani Gangavaram Port MoU with NMDC and Vale S.A. was signed at which forum?
x: The iron ore blending MoU was signed at the India–Brazil Business Forum in Delhi.

s: The 30-acre women entrepreneurs' industrial park was taken up under which policy?
x: The APEDB–FICCI FLO park is a plug-and-play facility under the AP Private Industrial Parks Policy 2024–29.

s: With which organisation did APEDB sign an MoU for a 30-acre women entrepreneurs' industrial park?
x: The APEDB–FICCI FLO MoU is for a 30-acre plug-and-play women entrepreneurs' park.

s: At what price does Andhra Pradesh offer land to Fortune 500 investors under its investment strategy?
x: AP offers land at 99 paise to Fortune 500 investors and targets 20 lakh jobs in five years.

s: At which place is the AP Futuristic Innovation and Research in Science and Technology (AP FIRST) centre located?
x: The AP FIRST research centre is located at Tirupati. Visakhapatnam was proposed as an AI hub, while Vijayawada and Amaravati are associated with other developments and events.

s: Taramandal, a Visakhapatnam-based space-tech start-up, is developing a prototype of India's first what?
x: Taramandal is developing India's first orbital satellite data centre prototype in the 60-kg class.

s: With which design is Taramandal's orbital satellite data centre prototype built?
o: Modular, stackable modules joined by docking technology
x: The prototype uses modular, stackable modules joined by docking technology, for AI workloads and disaster prediction.

s: The International Year of Quantum Science and Technology, 2025, marked how many years of quantum mechanics?
x: It marked 100 years of quantum mechanics; the APSCHE quantum training initiative was aligned with it.

s: At the AI Impact Summit, the proposed AI–Quantum Centre of Excellence with the UN International Computing Centre was to be established by year-end at which location?
x: The AI–Quantum Centre of Excellence with the UN International Computing Centre was proposed for Amaravati Quantum Valley as an AI–Quantum Digital Embassy. Bharat Mandapam was the venue where the MoUs were signed, while Geneva is associated with the establishment of the UN International Computing Centre.

s: Inspired by the Amaravati Quantum Declaration and the National Quantum Mission, how many people does the APSCHE quantum training initiative aim to train?
x: APSCHE plans to train 1,000+ faculty and about 1,00,000 students in quantum technologies.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Amaravati Quantum Valley?
o: It is described as India's 'quantum gateway'
Its internship collaboration was between TCS and T-Hub
The jury of its hackathon included IBM and TCS
The AP MoU partner group included the UN International Computing Centre and IIT Madras
x: The internship collaboration was IBM with T-Hub; IBM and TCS formed the jury.

s: When was the ground-breaking ceremony for Quantum Valley near Uddandarayunipalem in Amaravati held?
x: The foundation-laying of Quantum Valley took place on 7 February 2026 near Uddandarayunipalem.

s: At the AI Impact Summit, Andhra Pradesh signed MoUs with how many institutions?
x: AP signed MoUs with seven institutions at Bharat Mandapam, including UNICC, IBM and IIT Madras.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Taramandal's orbital satellite data centre initiative?
o: It is seeking institutional support from NASA
It is associated with global players from Israel and Australia
It has academic collaboration with AU Engineering College
Google, Reliance, Adani and Airtel investments highlight Vizag as a data-centre hub
x: Taramandal is seeking support from IN-SPACe, not NASA; AU Engineering College is its academic partner and it has partners from Israel and Australia.

s: When was the Amaravati Quantum Declaration adopted?
x: The Amaravati Quantum Declaration came on 30 June 2025; the Quantum Valley bhoomi puja was on 7 February 2026.

s: At which venue did Andhra Pradesh sign MoUs with seven institutions during the AI Impact Summit?
x: AP signed MoUs with seven institutions at Bharat Mandapam in the CM's presence.

s: How is the human-carrier drone ambulance announced by Andhra Pradesh designed to operate?
o: Only within visual line of sight (VLOS)
Only in extended visual line of sight (EVLOS)
x: The drone ambulance is designed for BVLOS operations, and a paramedic can accompany the patient.

s: Who provided guidance for Andhra Pradesh’s human-carrier drone ambulance initiative?
x: Guidance for the human-carrier drone ambulance initiative was provided by G. Satheesh Reddy, former DRDO Chairman and Andhra Pradesh’s Aero Defence Adviser. The other options are associated with different Andhra Pradesh initiatives.

s: Which institutions are supporting the development of Andhra Pradesh’s human-carrier drone ambulance?
o: Kalam Advanced UAV Research Centre (Anna University) and IIT Tirupati
Kalam Advanced UAV Research Centre (Anna University) and IIT Hyderabad
x: The drone ambulance is supported by the Kalam Advanced UAV Research Centre at Anna University and IIT Tirupati.

s: With reference to AP’s human-carrier drone ambulance, which pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Proposed drone port and hub – Visakhapatnam
x: The proposed drone port and hub is at Vijayawada, not Visakhapatnam; the other pairs are correct.

s: Who announced the establishment of India’s first integrated Aviation, Aerospace and Defence (AAD) EduCity near Bhogapuram International Airport?
x: HRD and IT Minister N. Lokesh announced India’s first integrated Aviation, Aerospace and Defence EduCity near Bhogapuram International Airport. N. Chandrababu Naidu, Sankhabrata Bagchi and Vangalapudi Anitha were not identified as the announcer of this EduCity.

s: Near which airport is India's first integrated Aviation, Aerospace and Defence EduCity planned?
x: The EduCity is planned near Bhogapuram International Airport under an MoU between the GMR Group and MANSAS Trust.

s: By which year is India's aircraft fleet projected to double to about 1,700?
x: The fleet is projected to double to about 1,700 by 2030, not 2026.

s: Which body was allowed to prepare the Terms of Reference for seven proposed water aerodromes in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The MoEF&CC Expert Appraisal Committee allowed AP Airports Development Corporation Ltd to prepare the ToR.

s: How many locations were proposed for Phase 2 of Andhra Pradesh's water aerodromes?
x: Phase 2 proposed three locations; seven locations were identified in Phase 1.

s: Which region is to get India's first-ever water aerodromes?
x: Andaman and Nicobar is to get the country's first-ever water aerodromes, not AP.

s: Dagadarthi greenfield airport, approved by the AP Cabinet in January 2026, is in which district?
x: Dagadarthi airport is in Nellore district, near Krishnapatnam and Ramayapatnam ports.

s: Which of the following is a Phase 1 location for water aerodromes in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Phase 1 covers Prakasam Barrage, Srisailam Dam, Lambasingi, Rushikonda, Kakinada, Jalaput and Gandikota; Konaseema, Tirupati and Araku are Phase 2.

s: Dagadarthi greenfield airport, approved in January 2026, will be which airport of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Dagadarthi in Nellore district will be the 8th airport in AP, near Krishnapatnam and Ramayapatnam ports.

s: What is the payload capacity of AP's human-carrier drone ambulance?
x: The drone ambulance carries up to 150 kg and operates beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS).

s: Which group is the developer of India's first integrated Aviation, Aerospace and Defence (AAD) EduCity near Bhogapuram, on land given by the MANSAS Trust?
x: The MoU is between GMR Group (developer) and MANSAS Trust, which gave 136 acres free of cost.

s: When was the validation flight held at Bhogapuram International Airport?
x: A validation flight was held at Bhogapuram airport in January 2026.

s: When did the Union Cabinet approve the South Coast Railway zone?
x: The Union Cabinet approved South Coast Railway in February 2025.

s: Under which law was the creation of South Coast Railway promised?
x: South Coast Railway was promised in the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.

s: Which Union ministry informed Parliament about the four major ports under construction in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
x: The Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways informed Parliament about the four major ports under construction in Andhra Pradesh. The Ministry of Railways is associated with the South Coast Railway development, not this port-related information.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the five pillars of Sagarmala?
x: The five pillars are port modernisation, port connectivity, port-led industrialisation, coastal community development, and coastal shipping and IWT; railway connectivity is not one.

s: Ramayapatnam port, under construction in Andhra Pradesh, is in which district?
x: Ramayapatnam is in SPSR Nellore district, not Prakasam.

s: What was the earlier name of Mulapeta port in Srikakulam district?
x: Mulapeta was formerly Bhavanapadu, in Srikakulam district.

s: In the reorganisation creating South Coast Railway, which division stayed with South Central Railway?
x: South Central Railway kept Secunderabad, Hyderabad and Nanded divisions; Guntakal, Guntur and Vijayawada went to SCoR.

s: Where is the headquarters of the South Coast Railway zone, which began operations on 1 June 2026?
x: South Coast Railway is headquartered at Visakhapatnam; East Coast Railway (2003) is headquartered at Bhubaneswar.

s: In which district is Machilipatnam port, one of the four major ports under construction in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Machilipatnam port is in Krishna district; Mulapeta is in Srikakulam and Ramayapatnam in SPSR Nellore.

s: Where is the headquarters of the East Coast Railway, established in 2003?
x: The East Coast Railway (2003) has its headquarters at Bhubaneswar.

s: In which year was the South Central Railway, headquartered at Secunderabad, established?
x: The South Central Railway was formed in 1966 with headquarters at Secunderabad.

s: Prakasam district is a hub for which type of tobacco?
x: Prakasam is a hub for FCV tobacco.

s: What is the new command area of the Polavaram project?
x: The new command area is 7.2 lakh acres; the Left Main Canal serves 4 lakh and the Right Main Canal 3.2 lakh acres.

s: Who directed that the Polavaram project be completed by July 2027?
x: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed completion of Polavaram by July 2027.

s: Why was advance readiness of the Polavaram project required before July 2027?
x: The project was required to be ready before the Godavari Pushkaralu 2027. The other events were not cited as the reason for the revised completion schedule.

s: The Polavaram multipurpose project, providing irrigation, drinking water, hydropower and flood mitigation, is on which river?
x: Polavaram is on the Godavari and provides irrigation, drinking water, hydropower and flood mitigation.

s: With reference to Polavaram, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: The final FRL is 45.72 m (194.6 TMC). The initial height is 41.11 m (124.2 TMC), ECRF Gap-2 was advanced to July 2027, and stabilisation covers 13.5 lakh acres.

s: Which one of the following statements regarding the Polavaram Project is correct?
o: It is a national project on the Godavari, with completion targeted for March 2027 and ₹6,105 crore provided in the 2026–27 Budget.
It is a river-linking project on the Godavari, already fully completed by September 2026.
It is a State project on the Krishna, with completion targeted for August 2026 and ₹1,638.52 crore provided.
It is a national project on the Pennar, with completion targeted for December 2027 and ₹15,000 crore provided.
x: Polavaram is a national project on the Godavari; completion is targeted for March 2027 (latest target, reaffirmed by the CM in Jul and Sep 2026; the original deadline was Dec 2027) and ₹6,105 crore was provided in the 2026–27 Budget.

s: The 57th Formation Day of Prakasam district was observed at which place as a tribute to Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu, known as “Andhra Kesari”?
x: The 57th Formation Day of Prakasam district was observed at Ongole as a tribute to Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu. Visakhapatnam and Mangalagiri are associated with other events in the period, not this Formation Day occasion.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Prakasam district's 57th Formation Day?
o: Four-laning of the road to Bestavaripeta was named a priority.
The announcements were made by the Agriculture Minister.
It paid tribute to Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu.
x: The announcements were made by Social Welfare Minister Dola Sree Bala Veeranjaneya Swamy, not the Agriculture Minister.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Krishna basin?
o: It covers Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
Its disputes fall under the ISRWD Act, 1956.
x: The Krishna basin covers Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and AP, not Odisha.

s: The Korisapadu lift-irrigation project is located in which district?
x: Korisapadu lift irrigation is in Prakasam district, not Palnadu.

s: Almatti Dam, whose height increase Karnataka proposed, is the main reservoir of which project?
x: Almatti is the main reservoir of the Upper Krishna Irrigation Project; CM Naidu objected to raising its height.

s: With which States did the Polavaram project require inter-state coordination?
x: Inter-state coordination was required with Telangana and Chhattisgarh.

s:
Assertion (A): The headworks of the Polavaram project are 80% completed.
Reason (R): Polavaram is a National Multipurpose Irrigation Project on the Godavari.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both the assertion and the reason are true: the headworks are 80% completed, and Polavaram is a National Multipurpose Irrigation Project on the Godavari. However, the project’s classification does not explain the stated percentage of headworks completion.

s: The Polavaram project rests on which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
x: Polavaram's legal basis is Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, not Section 89.

s: Which districts are served by the Polavaram Left Main Canal (4 lakh acres)?
x: The LMC serves East Godavari and Visakhapatnam; the RMC serves West Godavari and Krishna.

s: The Veligonda (Poola Subbaiah) project draws floodwater from which reservoir?
x: Veligonda draws Srisailam floodwater for Prakasam, Nellore and Kadapa.

s: After bifurcation, on NITI Aayog's advice, how is the Polavaram project being built?
o: The Centre builds it and the State funds it
The State Government builds it and the Centre funds it
It is built under PPP by a private company
It is built jointly by AP and Telangana
x: After bifurcation the State Government builds Polavaram and the Centre provides the money.

s: Donakonda, named an industrial hub with a large land bank, is in which district?
x: Donakonda in Prakasam district was named an industrial hub at the district's 57th Formation Day.

s: With which national programme is the Generation Z-themed post office at Andhra University aligned?
x: The initiative is aligned with Digital India, not the Smart Cities Mission.

s: Where was Andhra Pradesh's first Generation Z-themed post office set up?
x: AP's first Gen Z-themed post office was set up at Andhra University, Visakhapatnam.

s: BharatNet began in 2011 under which name?
x: BharatNet began in 2011 as NOFN (National Optical Fibre Network) and was renamed BharatNet in 2015. USOF is a different fund, renamed Digital Bharat Nidhi in 2023.

s: What is the area of Sri Venkateswara National Park, established in September 1989?
x: Sri Venkateswara National Park covers 353 sq km, not 535 sq km.

s: Pallepandaga 2.0 targets how many Mini Gokulams?
x: Pallepandaga 2.0 targets 25,000 Mini Gokulams and 8,000 km of rural roads.

s: Which two new army ant species were discovered around Sri Venkateswara Wildlife Sanctuary in the southern Eastern Ghats of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The newly discovered species are Aenictus chittoorensis and Aenictus lankamallensis, found around Sri Venkateswara Wildlife Sanctuary. The other combinations contain species names not associated with this discovery.

s: The Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh envisages a bioshield about 5 km wide along a coastline of how many km?
x: Launched by the AP Forest Department, it envisages a 5 km-wide bioshield along the 974 km coastline.

s: Who directed that the green-cover initiative be fast-tracked and unclassified mangroves be protected in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Deputy CM and Forest Minister K. Pawan Kalyan directed that green cover be fast-tracked and unclassified mangroves be protected. G. Satheesh Reddy is linked to the drone ambulance, and N. Chandrababu Naidu is the Chief Minister.

s: The Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh has three zones: mangroves at river mouths, windbreaks on canal bunds and roads, and which third zone?
x: The third zone is village agroforestry; the plan responds to disaster losses of about ₹2.25 lakh crore over 30 years.

s: Which initiative was launched in 2023 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change after India joined the Mangrove Alliance for Climate at COP27, and covers coastline and salt pan lands?
o: Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh
x: MISHTI was launched in 2023 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change after India joined the Mangrove Alliance for Climate at COP27, and it covers coastline and salt pan lands. The Mangrove Alliance for Climate is the alliance India joined, not the initiative described.

s: What is the primary objective of the Sacred Herbal Garden proposed by TTD in Tirumala?
o: To commemorate legendary Telugus in the Constituent Assembly
To display 12 iconic wild animal species of Andhra Pradesh
To link Indian Knowledge Systems with modern science
To conserve rare and endangered medicinal plants of the Seshachalam forests
x: The TTD Sacred Herbal Garden at Tirumala (4 acres, 13 thematic zones) is meant to conserve the medicinal plants of the Seshachalam forests.

s: Under Pallepandaga 2.0, what was the total number of works and financial outlay announced by Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan?
x: Pallepandaga 2.0 comprises 53,382 works with an outlay of ₹6,700 crore. The other combinations refer to specific components or separate programmes, not the overall Pallepandaga 2.0 announcement.

s: Under Pallepandaga 2.0, how many km of rural roads are planned?
x: Pallepandaga 2.0 plans 8,000 km of rural roads; 4,300 km were done under Pallepandaga 1.0.

s: Under which name are Andhra Pradesh's Jal Jeevan Mission projects worth ₹7,910 crore taken up?
x: Jal Jeevan Mission in AP is called Amarajeevi Jaladhara: 5 projects, ₹7,910 crore, by 2027.

s: About how many acres of unclassified mangroves in AP, identified by satellite, are to be notified as protected forests?
x: About 10,000 acres of unclassified mangroves are to be notified as protected forests.

s: In which year was the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve notified?
x: The Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve was notified in 2010; Sri Venkateswara National Park dates from 1989.

s: How many devotees died in the Vaikuntha Ekadasi stampede at Tirumala in January 2025?
x: Six devotees died during darshan token distribution in the Vaikuntha Ekadasi stampede.

s: Under Tirupati district's "No Helmet, No Petrol" rule, about what share of two-wheeler deaths was described as preventable with helmets?
x: About 40% of such deaths were reported preventable with helmets; 45% is the share of road deaths involving two-wheeler riders.

s: What was the notable first-ever reform introduced for the first three days of Vaikuntha Ekadasi at TTD?
o: Digital payments in all 60 TTD-managed temples
Central Silk Board testing of shawls
x: TTD introduced first-ever online-only Sarva Darshan tokens for the first three days of Vaikuntha Ekadasi. Digital payments and the electric mobility master plan were separate reforms.

s: What distinction did Andhra Pradesh announce in January 2026 in the field of emergency medical transport?
o: India’s first drone-based crop insurance service
x: Andhra Pradesh announced India’s first human-carrier drone ambulance. The other options do not describe the announced innovation.

s: With which body did the AP Tourism Department organise the National Tourism Mart–2025 in Visakhapatnam?
o: Association of Domestic Tour Operators of India (ADTOI)
Federation of Associations in Indian Tourism and Hospitality (FAITH)
x: The Mart was organised by AP Tourism with ADTOI under a signed MoU.

s: The National Tourism Mart–2025 was scheduled to be hosted in which city on 13–14 February 2026?
x: Visakhapatnam hosted the National Tourism Mart–2025 on 13–14 February 2026, organised by AP Tourism with ADTOI.

s: Which agencies probed the TTD-related controversies in 2025?
o: CBI-led SIT, NIA, ACB and FSSAI
CBI-led SIT, CID, ACB and FSSAI
CBI-led SIT, CID, ED and FSSAI
x: The probes involved the CBI-led SIT, CID, ACB and FSSAI.

s: Which tourism segments were highlighted at the National Tourism Mart–2025?
o: Coastal, spiritual, heritage, eco-adventure and medical tourism
Coastal, spiritual, cruise, eco-adventure and tribal tourism
Coastal, spiritual, heritage, eco-adventure and tribal tourism
Coastal, wellness, heritage, eco-adventure and tribal tourism
x: The Mart highlighted coastal, spiritual, heritage, eco-adventure and tribal tourism, with places such as Araku, Lambasingi and Maredumilli.

s: Who announced that December 15 would be observed annually as the “Day of Sacrifice” in honour of Amarajeevi Potti Sriramulu?
x: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu announced that December 15 would be observed annually as the “Day of Sacrifice” honouring Amarajeevi Potti Sriramulu. N. Lokesh was associated with the Aviation, Aerospace and Defence EduCity announcement, not this declaration.

s: Under Tirupati district's “No Helmet, No Petrol” rule from December 15, helmets are compulsory for whom?
o: Both the rider and the pillion passenger
Neither the rider nor the pillion passenger
x: The rule requires helmets for both the rider and the pillion passenger on a two-wheeler. It was implemented from December 15, and the alternatives incorrectly limit or remove the helmet requirement.

s: Where is Potti Sriramulu's residence to be memorialised?
x: His residence is at Nellore; the building where he fasted is at Chennai, and Smruthi Vanam and the Statue of Sacrifice are at Amaravati.

s: At which programme was the annual observance of December 15 as the “Day of Sacrifice” announced?
o: Sriramulu's Atmarpana Day programme in Vijayawada
x: The announcement was made at Sriramulu's Atmarpana Day programme in Vijayawada. Amaravati, Kurnool and Chennai are associated with other historical or memorial details, not the stated venue of the announcement.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Potti Sriramulu and the formation of Andhra State?
o: Potti Sriramulu undertook a 58-day fast unto death and died on 15 December
Andhra State was formed on 1 October 1953
Andhra State was formed with Hyderabad as its capital
Andhra Pradesh was formed on 1 November 1956
x: Andhra State (1953) had Kurnool as its capital, not Hyderabad.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Anga Vastram scam at TTD?
o: It was confirmed by Central Silk Board laboratory tests.
It continued for nearly a decade.
Polyester shawls were supplied as pure cotton.
x: The polyester shawls were passed off as pure mulberry silk, not pure cotton.

s: Which were the legacy issues associated with TTD in 2025?
o: Parakamani irregularities, adulterated ghee in laddu prasadam and engineering works
Digital payments, adulterated ghee in laddu prasadam and engineering works
Parakamani irregularities, adulterated ghee in laddu prasadam and the electric mobility plan
Parakamani irregularities, online-only tokens and engineering works
x: The legacy issues were Parakamani cash-counting irregularities, adulterated ghee in laddu prasadam and engineering works; online tokens, digital payments and e-mobility were reforms.

s: With reference to TTD-related probes, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Ghee case – Central Silk Board laboratory confirmation
Anga Vastram scam – Palm oil derivatives detected
x: The Parakamani case is under High Court monitoring. The ghee case saw a CBI-SIT report to the Supreme Court (palm oil derivatives detected), and the Anga Vastram scam was confirmed by the Central Silk Board.

s: The 600-bed Kanuri–GMCANA Mother and Child Care Centre was inaugurated at which hospital?
x: The 600-bed MCH block is at Government General Hospital, Guntur, inaugurated by CM Naidu on 30 January 2026.

s: By whom was the Mother and Child Care Centre at Guntur GGH mainly funded?
o: Guntur Medical College alumni of North America
x: The ₹100-crore block was funded by GMCANA, the Guntur Medical College alumni of North America; it is not a new medical college.

s: Which was the capital of Andhra State, formed on 1 October 1953 after Potti Sriramulu's fast?
x: Andhra State (1 October 1953) had Kurnool as capital; Andhra Pradesh followed on 1 November 1956.

x: Article 226 covers Fundamental Rights and other legal rights, so writs are not limited to Fundamental Rights; Article 215 makes a High Court a Court of Record.

x: AP's coastline is 1,053 km; 1,465 km is the Godavari's length.

s: Who built the Dowleswaram Barrage on the Godavari near Rajamahendravaram?
x: The Dowleswaram Barrage at Rajamahendravaram was built by Sir Arthur Cotton.

s: Which is the second-longest river of India after the Ganga?
x: The Godavari (Dakshin Ganga), about 1,465 km long, is the second-longest river after the Ganga.

s: In which year was the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act enacted?
x: The use of the State Emblem is regulated by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

s: Which village in Tirupati recorded its first land registration in nearly five decades?
x: Settipalle village in Tirupati recorded its first land registration in nearly five decades. It coincided with a ₹1,766 crore township proposed by TUDA.

s: The first land registration in nearly five decades at Settipalle, Tirupati, coincided with a township proposed by which authority?
x: The registration at Settipalle coincided with a ₹1,766 crore township proposed by the Tirupati Urban Development Authority (TUDA).

s: Which of the following is correct about the revised pattadar passbooks distributed in Nandyal district?
o: Part of the Record of Rights and a facilitating document, not conclusive proof of title
Conclusive proof of title guaranteed by the State
Title documents issued under the AP Land Titling Act
x: The passbook is part of the Record of Rights (ownership, extent, survey number) and only a facilitating document; the AP Land Titling Act was repealed.

s: The "Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor" programme covers how many poor families?
x: The programme covers 5 lakh poor families in inaccessible areas of 7 districts, planned over 3 years.

s: The 'Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor' programme is implemented with which organisation?
o: AP State Commission for Protection of Child Rights
Indian Red Cross Society, AP branch
x: Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor ('Your Doctor at Your Home') is run with the Indian Red Cross Society, AP branch.

s: Which groups are specifically prioritised under Andhra Pradesh’s “Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor” doorstep healthcare programme?
o: Pregnant women, children aged 0–6 years, and bedridden persons
Pregnant women and children aged 0–6 years only
Children aged 0–6 years and bedridden persons only
Pregnant women and bedridden persons only
x: The programme focuses on pregnant women, children aged 0–6 years, and bedridden persons. The tempting alternatives omit one of these three priority groups, so they do not state the complete focus of the programme.

s: Under which system of land titling does the State guarantee title?
x: Only conclusive titling carries a State guarantee of title; under presumptive titling the State does not guarantee title.

s: Which one of the following statements about land registration and records is incorrect?
o: Section 22A of the Registration Act, 1908, enables States to prohibit registration of certain lands.
Stamp duty is collected by the States.
The Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme digitises land records.
Mutation by itself confers title to land.
x: The incorrect statement is that mutation by itself confers title; mutation does not confer title. Section 22A concerns prohibition of registration of certain lands, stamp duty is collected by States, and DILRMP digitises land records.

s: 'Land' is included in which entry of the State List?
x: Land is Entry 18 of the State List; Parliament can legislate on it under Articles 249, 250 and 252.

s: What is the compensation for death due to human–wildlife conflict under Project HANUMAN?
x: Compensation for death is ₹10 lakh; ₹2 lakh is for injury.

s: What are the 'Vajra' teams under Project HANUMAN?
x: Vajra teams are village volunteer teams; Rapid Response Teams form the immediate response mechanism.

s: How is livestock loss due to human–wildlife conflict compensated under Project HANUMAN?
x: Livestock loss is compensated at market value, while injury attracts ₹2 lakh.

s: The 'Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor' programme was launched on 8 May 2026. Which day is observed on 8 May?
x: 8 May is World Red Cross Day (and World Thalassemia Day); the Governor launched the programme that day.

s: Who launched Project HANUMAN on human–wildlife conflict on World Wildlife Day 2026?
x: Deputy CM and Forest Minister Pawan Kalyan launched Project HANUMAN at Mangalagiri on 3 March 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four Wildlife Rescue & Treatment Centres under Project HANUMAN?
x: The four centres are Visakhapatnam, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati and Bairaluti; Nellore is not one.

s:
Consider the following statements about land records in Andhra Pradesh:
1. A pattadar passbook is conclusive proof of title.
2. The AP Land Titling Act was repealed by the Naidu government.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statement 2 is correct; a pattadar passbook is part of the Record of Rights, a facilitating document and not conclusive proof of title.

s: In which event did Mogili Venkatram Reddy of Andhra Pradesh win gold at the 22nd Asian U20 Athletics Championships, Hong Kong?
x: He won the men's 800 m gold on 31 May 2026 with a personal best of 1:48.27.

s: Who is the chairman of the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP)?
x: Animini Ravi Naidu is the SAAP chairman.

s: What horizontal reservation in government jobs does the May 2026 amendment to the AP Sports Policy 2024–29 give sportspersons?
x: G.O.Ms.No.23 (14 May 2026) provides 3% horizontal reservation; candidates are scrutinised by SAAP.

s: What is the State bird of residual Andhra Pradesh?
x: Residual AP's bird is the Rama Chiluka; the Indian Roller was the bird of undivided AP.

s: Which of the following pairs (State symbol of residual Andhra Pradesh) is correctly matched?
x: Residual AP's animal is the Blackbuck, tree Neem (Vepa), flower Jasmine and bird Rama Chiluka.

s: In which year were the State symbols of residual Andhra Pradesh notified by GO No. 59?
x: They were notified in 2018 by GO No. 59, four years after bifurcation.
